name: The Valley of Serenity
description: A huge pastoral cavern region of the House where the cult lives.

description_citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
description_citations.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: City, outside the door, tells Dawn he asked the Devouring Father to spare her and invites her to the Valley of Serenity.
timeline.quote: I asked him for your life, and he granted it to me

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter warns that they have entered the Valley of Serenity, home of the Cult of Valgavoth; Nashi insists on continuing.
timeline.quote: The Cult of Valgavoth lives here.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter explains the cult's belief and that it captures survivors to convert or feed to Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: They claim Duskmourn was created by an entity summoned by their ancestors

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The party enters a cavern of robed cultists who hold three bound survivors and hang chrysalises.
timeline.quote: Half a dozen humanoid figures in long robes shaped like moth's wings

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A frightened captive accepts the cult's offer and is led toward a chrysalis.
timeline.quote: As a group, they pulled her toward the nearest chrysalis, which was split down the middle, and began to ease her inside.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko leaps onto a stalagmite and challenges the cultists.
timeline.quote: They jumped onto the nearest stalagmite, a shard appearing in either hand.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Cultists seize the Wanderer, Nashi and Niko while Winter bows his head and does not resist.
timeline.quote: Winter only bowed his head, saying nothing, as the cultists rose up and grabbed Niko in turn.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter drops a granite slab that seals the others in with the cultists.
timeline.quote: A slab of solid granite crashed down between him and the others, sealing them in the room with the cultists.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The cult leader's book releases silver dust that knocks the captives unconscious.
timeline.quote: their leader raised his book and blew across the pages, and a thick layer of dust rolled off the paper

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer wakes bound to a post in a larger cavern.
timeline.quote: she was able to shake off the lingering effects of the sedative dust to find herself held up by loops of some white, cottony material, pinning her tightly to a post.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer sees Tamiyo's scroll echo held in a device as a cultist records her stories.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo's scroll echo floated there, flickering in and out of focus, like it hurt her to be manifest.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The cult leader says Valgavoth can now spread to more worlds merely by knowing they exist.
timeline.quote: He no longer needs to strain with all his might to open a door.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The cult leader offers the Wanderer a chance to join them.
timeline.quote: we would be gloriously glad if you would join us

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

pages_say.description: The place where City invites Dawn to join his group for the Devouring Father's peace.
